notes.title: Update notes: Tips
notes.content:
Tips section added to the Information menu.

Here are the Tips:
[olist]
[*] When two large planets merge, the small planet in between can easily bounce out of the bubble. To prevent this, merge the small planet into larger planets, or place larger planets on top of the small one.
[*] Earth can fit over Saturn.
[*] Venus can fit over Jupiter.
[*] Mars can fit over the Sun.
[/olist]
